items.memory_vault_page: the memory vault is now a full-screen Activity (MemoryVaultActivity) instead of a dialog: status-bar inset, Close button, kind picker, search, add field, pending entry, grouped list that opens MemoryDetailPanel on tap
items.host_interface: MemoryDetailPanel no longer depends on MainActivity; it takes a MemoryHost interface implemented by both screens
items.step_highlight: the step a running or waiting task is on gets a tinted row in the plan tree
items.home_cards: only Local Planner and Sensors stay on the page; Hardware, Daemon, Archive and Vision moved into the Diagnostics panel

device_evidence.home: page shows Diagnostics, Local Planner, Sensors, then tasks

note: the step highlight cannot be photographed for local tasks because both steps finish in under a second
